name: pminsight
description: Production-grade multi-tenant Project Management Practice System aligned with PMI standards

scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm --filter web dev" "cd apps/api && dotnet watch run"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter web build && cd apps/api && dotnet build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter web test && cd apps/api && dotnet test
scripts.clean: pnpm -r clean && cd apps/api && dotnet clean
